title: valeriana atlantica
intro: Valeriana atlantica, commonly known as the Atlantic valerian or Madeira valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is native to the Atlantic Islands and is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The health benefits of Valeriana atlantica include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing stress and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include valepotriates, isovaleric acid, and valerenic acid, which are known for their sedative and anxiolytic effects.
